create.create_life_totals: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS life_totals (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, total INTEGER NOT NULL);
create.create_todo_list: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todo_list (id integer primary key AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, task_assigned_time_stamp TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')), task_closed_time_stamp TEXT, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, task_details text not null, task_priority integer not null default 3);
create.create_reminders: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, archived integer not null default 0);

select.select_life_totals_by_user_id: SELECT total FROM life_totals WHERE user_id = ?;
select.select_active_tasks_by_user_id: SELECT id, task_assigned_time_stamp, task_details, task_priority FROM todo_list WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 0 ORDER BY task_priority ASC, task_assigned_time_stamp ASC;
select.select_archived_tasks_by_user_id: SELECT id, task_assigned_time_stamp, task_closed_time_stamp, task_details, task_priority FROM todo_list WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 1 ORDER BY task_closed_time_stamp DESC;
select.select_task_by_id: SELECT id, user_id, task_assigned_time_stamp, task_closed_time_stamp, archived, task_details, task_priority FROM todo_list WHERE id = ?;
select.select_all_reminders: SELECT id, user_id, archived FROM reminders WHERE archived = 0;
select.select_active_tasks_by_user_id_and_prior: SELECT id, task_assigned_time_stamp, task_details, task_priority FROM todo_list WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 0 AND task_priority = ? ORDER BY task_assigned_time_stamp ASC;
select.select_inactive_tasks_by_user_id_and_pri: SELECT id, task_assigned_time_stamp, task_details, task_priority FROM todo_list WHERE user_id = ? AND archived = 1 AND task_priority = ? ORDER BY task_assigned_time_stamp ASC;
select.select_reminder_by_user_id: SELECT id, user_id, archived FROM reminders WHERE user_id = ?;

insert.insert_task_by_user_id_and_task_priority: INSERT INTO todo_list (user_id, task_details, task_priority) VALUES (?, ?, ?);

update.update_life_totals_by_user_id: UPDATE life_totals SET total = ? WHERE user_id = ?;
update.update_task_details_by_id: UPDATE todo_list SET task_details = ? WHERE id = ?;
update.update_task_priority_by_id: UPDATE todo_list SET task_priority = ? WHERE id = ?;
update.archive_task_by_id: UPDATE todo_list SET archived = 1, task_closed_time_stamp = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?;
update.unarchive_task_by_id: UPDATE todo_list SET archived = 0, task_closed_time_stamp = NULL WHERE id = ?;
update.archive_reminder_by_id: UPDATE reminders SET archived = 1 WHERE id = ?;
update.unarchive_reminder_by_id: UPDATE reminders SET archived = 0 WHERE id = ?;
